--- a/src/swancom1.f90

@@ -6664,6 +6664,7 @@ SUBROUTINE SWCOMP (AC1        ,AC2        ,&
                   INTEGER, SAVE :: IENT = 0
                   INTEGER           :: ID, IDIA, IDC, IERR, IS, ISC, IT
                   INTEGER           :: N2, LMAX
+                  INTEGER           :: IZS, IZDLO, IZDHI
 
                   REAL              :: DQ, DQ2, DT2
 
@@ -6807,20 +6808,34 @@ SUBROUTINE SWCOMP (AC1        ,AC2        ,&
                      IMATDA = 0.
                   ENDIF
 
-!     *** set all dissipation coeff at 0 ***
-
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc0(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MDISP) = 0.
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc1(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MDISP) = 0.
-
-!     *** set all generation coeff at 0 ***
-
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%genc0(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MGENR) = 0.
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%genc1(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MGENR) = 0.
-
-!     *** set all redistribution coeff at 0 ***
-
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%redc0(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MREDS) = 0.
-                  SOURCE_BUDGET%redc1(1:MDC,1:MSC,1:MREDS) = 0.
+!     *** set all dissipation, generation and redistribution coeff at 0 ***
+!
+!     Only the bins of the current sweep sector are cleared.  Every source
+!     routine accumulates over exactly IS = 1, ISSTOP and IDDUM = IDCMIN(IS),
+!     IDCMAX(IS), and ADDDIS reads only bins with ANYBIN set, which SWPSEL
+!     constructs inside that same range.  Bins outside it are therefore
+!     neither written nor read and need not be cleared.
+
+                  DO IZS = 1, WINDOW%ISSTOP
+                     IZDLO = WINDOW%IDCMIN(IZS)
+                     IZDHI = WINDOW%IDCMAX(IZS)
+                     IF (IZDHI .LT. IZDLO) CYCLE
+                     IF (IZDLO .LT. 1) THEN
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc0(IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MDISP) = 0.
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc1(IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MDISP) = 0.
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%genc0 (IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MGENR) = 0.
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%genc1 (IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MGENR) = 0.
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%redc0 (IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MREDS) = 0.
+                        SOURCE_BUDGET%redc1 (IZDLO+MDC:MDC,IZS,1:MREDS) = 0.
+                        IZDLO = 1
+                     END IF
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc0(IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MDISP) = 0.
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc1(IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MDISP) = 0.
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%genc0 (IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MGENR) = 0.
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%genc1 (IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MGENR) = 0.
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%redc0 (IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MREDS) = 0.
+                     SOURCE_BUDGET%redc1 (IZDLO:IZDHI,IZS,1:MREDS) = 0.
+                  END DO
 
 !     *** set local ice concentration ***
 !     (see Remarks)
method: One serial process pinned to one CPU. All timings include process startup and output, including binary hotfile writing. Preparation and copying input hotfiles excluded. Wind direction, boundary, grid and physics package fixed. Exploratory measurements, not release qualification.

runs.label: q2
runs.deck:
$ ----------------------------------------------------------------------
$ Stationary Voordelta demonstration on Rijkswaterstaat bathymetry
$ Coordinates: Amersfoort / RD New (EPSG:28992), vertical datum: NAP
$ Domain: x=20-85 km, y=380-450 km; water level fixed at NAP
$ ----------------------------------------------------------------------

PROJECT 'VOORDELT' '001'
SET LEVEL 0.0 NAUTICAL
MODE STATIONARY TWODIMENSIONAL
COORDINATES CARTESIAN

$ Computational grid: 500 m, 130 x 140 meshes (131 x 141 points).
$ Spectral grid: 36 directions and 24 frequency meshes, 0.04-1.0 Hz.
CGRID REGULAR 20000.0 380000.0 0.0 65000.0 70000.0 130 140 &
      CIRCLE 36 0.04 1.0 24

$ Bathymetry grid: 250 m, positive water depth relative to NAP.
$ -999 marks land or cells without bathymetric coverage.
INPGRID BOTTOM REGULAR 20000.0 380000.0 0.0 260 280 250.0 250.0 &
        EXCEPTION -999.0
READINP BOTTOM 1.0 'voordelta.dep' 3 0 FREE

$ Illustrative stationary westerly storm. These are synthetic forcing values,
$ not observations and not an operational or calibrated design condition.
WIND 15.0 270.0
BOUND SHAPESPEC JONSWAP 3.3 PEAK DSPR DEGREES
BOUNDSPEC SIDE WEST CONSTANT PAR 2.0 7.5 270.0 25.0

GEN3 KOMEN
QUADRUPL 2
NUMERIC STOPC STAT MXITST=100
BREAKING CONSTANT 1.0 0.73
FRICTION JONSWAP CONSTANT 0.038

$ Full-domain maps and three easy-to-inspect locations.
BLOCK 'COMPGRID' NOHEADER 'voordelta_depth.blk' LAYOUT 3 DEPTH
BLOCK 'COMPGRID' NOHEADER 'voordelta_hs.blk' LAYOUT 3 HSIGN
POINTS 'SITES' 30000.0 430000.0 45000.0 420000.0 55000.0 440000.0
TABLE 'SITES' HEADER 'voordelta_sites.tbl' XP YP DEPTH HSIGN TM01 DIR

COMPUTE
HOTFILE 'end.hot' UNFORMATTED
STOP
